purpose: Score external know-how before it changes permanent AI Army, video, clipping, or TikTok Shop standards. Preserve useful deltas, reject duplication and cargo-cult rules, and separate canonical rules from experiments.

disposition.CANONICAL_ADOPT: score >= 80 and no unresolved hard conflict
disposition.EXPERIMENT: 65 <= score < 80, or evidence/applicability still needs local calibration
disposition.HOLD_OR_REJECT: score < 65, duplicated with no net value, contradicted, unsafe, or not measurable

source_tiers.T1: Current official platform, standards body, original peer-reviewed paper, or directly reproducible repository/runtime evidence
source_tiers.T2: Mature OSS implementation, official engineering case study, or high-quality primary technical publication
source_tiers.T3: Independent empirical study with bounded population/generalizability
source_tiers.T4: Community practice, anecdote, creator advice, or AI reviewer hypothesis; experiment only unless independently corroborated

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Maintain source tier, applicability, retrieval/update context, and decision status for every permanent know-how delta.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: Prevents stale platform advice and unsupported cross-platform generalization.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Use one metric registry with exact metric IDs, availability rules, platform scope, baselines, guardrails, and rollback criteria.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: Turns qualitative know-how into auditable promotion/demotion decisions.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: When analytics are available, map retention dips/spikes/top moments/intro to scene IDs and edit features; feed only measured lessons into future generation. Never synthesize missing analytics.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: YouTube explicitly exposes retention moments and recommends experiment-driven revision.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Evaluate packaging CTR together with average view duration/retention and promise match; never promote clickbait on CTR alone.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: Official YouTube guidance warns that high CTR with low view duration is a bad signal.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Safe-zone checks are mandatory for platform exports, but exact insets are versioned platform data and must be refreshed rather than hardcoded universally.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: TikTok and Meta both explicitly require/encourage UI-safe composition.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Record integrated loudness, true peak, clipping and silence metrics; platform target values require verified platform evidence or calibrated experiment. Do not impose broadcast -23 LUFS as a social upload law.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: ITU provides a measurement standard; platform upload targets are separate and must not be invented.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Classify each creative experiment by the intended bottleneck in GMV = Impressions × Product CTR × CVR × AOV, and require downstream guardrails.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: Current Japan Seller University explicitly frames GMV through these stages.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Prefer dynamic real-use demonstrations, multiple angles/details, synchronized clear audio/video, and product-central framing over static/PDP-splice creatives.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: TikTok Shop official quality guidance repeatedly recommends these patterns.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Optimize verifiable trustworthiness, expertise and product evidence; do not treat increasingly 'authentic-looking' performance as a monotonic objective or fabricate UGC/testimonials.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: Empirical TikTok research supports trust/expertise while authenticity effects are not safely reducible to 'more is always better'.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Every architecture/routing benchmark persists effective config, topology, provider/model, per-request latency/tokens/tool calls/errors, P50/P95 aggregates and verifier/acceptance outcome.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: NVIDIA evaluation tooling demonstrates this reproducible profiling pattern and current policy already has most raw observability fields.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Shadow-test a calibrated router that selects single-agent vs bounded parallel specialists and model tier from decomposability, uncertainty, tool intensity, shared-state risk and provider health.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: ACL MasRouter supports adaptive collaboration/model routing, but local benefit must be proven against the existing deterministic facade before promotion.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Measure role-specific useful-context ratio and trigger structured compaction when fixture-calibrated thresholds are breached; no universal token threshold yet.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: Existing context quarantine is strong, but quantitative compaction calibration remains a useful experiment.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Use WhisperX-style VAD + forced alignment only for unknown/third-party speech when baseline alignment fails or precise clipping benefits justify the compute.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: Technically strong but existing policy already requires word-level alignment when needed; net novelty is limited.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Benchmark content-aware scene detection as an auxiliary candidate generator, followed by semantic/audio boundary refinement; never let detector thresholds define final cuts alone.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: Mature OSS supports scene detection, but the current semantic boundary policy already covers the final-decision layer.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Do not encode a universal scene-change interval.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: Official guidance emphasizes engagement/experimentation rather than a universal cut cadence; over-editing can harm comprehension.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Keep first-three-seconds as a TikTok priority/checkpoint and testable heuristic, not a cross-platform immutable law or sole success criterion.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: TikTok official sources emphasize it, while YouTube uses a different retention construct and all platforms require local analytics.

adjudicated_candidates.delta: Treat Japan guidance that best-performing shoppable videos are >30s and top sellers publish 5+ per week as account/category benchmarks to test, not mandatory production quotas.
adjudicated_candidates.reason: Official Japan guidance is valuable but correlational and may vary by product/account.
